# Embeddable Lemonade

Version: 2026.42.1. Upstream release: https://github.com/lemonade-sdk/lemonade/releases/tag/v2026.42.1

Official Windows x64 ZIP SHA-256: 6bc9b9f301aa8235f2e6a2a51d75f0ba0f9cb3580e65ff0ea4fc6752ef3a8f3f. This directory contains the unmodified `lemond.exe`, its resources and LICENSE from that archive.
